verdict.rationale: The Admin API documents deleting projects, environments, flags, segments, and users, which gives some product-level deletion control. Self-hosting gives operators full control over where their data lives. No configurable retention policy, retention period, or data-purge workflow is documented. Missing for 10: configurable data retention settings or windows, documented identity/trait/event-data deletion or GDPR erasure workflows, retention controls for audit logs and experimentation warehouse data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
